comment: Ratified four-level threshold table: spec/target-spec.md row 4 (ratified 2026-10-20, DR-001), 4 levels at 4 / 6 / 9 / 12 % below the 1.8 V nominal. Single source of truth for every bench driver and Python helper under sim/: bash drivers read it through lib/levels.sh (levels_load), helpers json.load it by path. The trip points are a ratified spec quantity: change them only through a decision record that supersedes the spec row, never to make a result pass.
